mapper.select: SELECT failure_count, locked_until FROM app.login_attempt WHERE username_key = #{usernameKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app.login_attempt (username_key, failure_count, locked_until, last_failed_at, retain_until) VALUES (#{usernameKey}, #{failures}, #{lockedUntil,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, CASE WHEN #{failures} > 0 THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE NULL END, clock_timestamp() + INTERVAL '1 day') ON CONFLICT (username_key) DO UPDATE SET failure_count = EXCLUDED.failure_count, locked_until = EXCLUDED.locked_until, last_failed_at = EXCLUDED.last_failed_at, retain_until = EXCLUDED.retain_until, version = app.login_attempt.version + 1, updated_at = clock_timestamp()
